subject: Your 3-minute audio fix
preview_text: The routine that makes your headphones 10x more effective. Takes 3 minutes. Works every time.
body_paragraphs: You probably already have a 3-minute routine. Coffee. Scrolling. Staring at the microwave. What if that routine made your headphones sound like a $2,000 rig?

Here's the trick that the 100,000 people on Loudify use: before you hit play on anything — Spotify, a podcast, a game — open the app and run the 3-minute tune. That's it. Set your profile (Music, Movie, etc.), let AutoEQ recognize your headphones, and bump the volume +50%. Not the system slider. The Loudify slider. No distortion. Just clean, loud sound where it matters.

The 3-minute routine is why our weekly Sound DNA reports show that users who do this listen 2x longer and report less ear fatigue. It's not about cranking it to 200% every time. It's about consistency. You build the habit, the app handles the tuning.

Open Loudify now and run the 3-minute tune before your next listen. P.S. Premium users get a weekly Sound DNA that shows exactly how this routine changes your listening habits. The first report is already waiting for you.
P.S. The top streak on the global leaderboard right now is 147 days. Someone's 3-minute routine is already a habit. Yours starts today.
